issue: Discipline picker shows placeholder labels "BAR — BAR" and "ISC — ISC" because those sections have no content; the learner cannot tell what BAR/ISC are or that they have no material.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j1-d-02-sections.png. Steps: fresh context -> #/welcome -> "Got it" -> open "Which discipline section will you take?" -> options read "BAR — BAR", "ISC — ISC", "TCP — Tax Compliance and Planning". Code: Onboarding.tsx falls back to `?? d` when content.sections lacks the id.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Add a static name map (BAR = Business Analysis and Reporting, ISC = Information Systems and Controls) and suffix "(no content yet)" for sections not in content.sections.
expected: Full section names, with a note when a section has no content.
steps: Open #/welcome in a fresh context, click "Got it — set up my plan", open the discipline select.

issue: The lesson completion button promises "Mark complete & practice (28 questions)" but opens a 10-question set. The count is every practice item in the module (questionsForModule), while PracticeStart builds the set with count: 10.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j2-d-09-before-complete.png (button label "Mark complete & practice (28 questions)"), review/screens/uj-j2-d-10-after-complete.png (quiz header "0/10 answered"). Steps: onboard FAR -> #/module/far-income-statement-oci -> scroll to "Finished reading?" -> click the button.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Label the button with the set size actually served, e.g. "Mark complete & practice (10 questions)" (Math.min(10, practiceCount)), or "practice 10 of 28 questions".
expected: The button states the number of questions in the set it starts.
steps: Open a lesson, click "Mark complete & practice (N questions)", compare N with the quiz header.

issue: Inline lesson questions each show a "Highlight selection" tool, but every McqView writes to one global CSS highlight ("exam-highlight"), so highlighting text in the second check question silently erases the highlight in the first. These question highlights are also ephemeral, while the lesson's own "Save highlight" is persistent: two unrelated highlight behaviours on one page.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j2b-d-03-check1-highlight-after-check2.png. Steps (desktop): open #/module/far-income-statement-oci, select the first words of check 1's stem, click its "Highlight selection" (CSS.highlights.get("exam-highlight").size = 1), do the same in check 2 -> size is still 1 and check 1's highlight is gone.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Hide the ephemeral highlight tool on inline lesson questions (showTools=false should cover it), or key the CSS highlight name per question (e.g. `exam-highlight-${q.id}` registered in CSS) so instances do not overwrite each other.
expected: Highlights in one inline question survive highlighting another, or the tool is not offered in lessons.
observed: Only the latest question keeps its highlight.
steps: Highlight text in two different "Check your understanding" questions on one lesson.

issue: Saved lesson highlights appear only in a list at the bottom of the page; the highlighted passage is not marked in the lesson text, and text in the warm-up question, "big idea" box and key takeaways cannot be highlighted (selection there shows no "Save highlight" button) although the tip says "select any text in the lesson".
evidence: review/screens/uj-j2b-d-01-body-selection.png, review/screens/uj-j2b-d-02-highlight-list.png, review/screens/uj-j2-d-07-selection.png. Steps: select a sentence in the body -> "Save highlight" -> no <mark>/CSS highlight in the body (count 0); select text in the pre-question explanation -> no button.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Render saved highlights inline (CSS Custom Highlight API or <mark>) and widen bodyRef to the big idea and takeaways, or reword the tip to "select text in the lesson body".

issue: The results page miscounts what entered spaced review. It reports missed + guessed-right, but needsRequeue() also queues correct answers rated "Unsure"; and when nothing was missed it says "Clean sweep. These will stay out of your review queue." even when Unsure answers were queued, or when half the test-mode set was unanswered and scored wrong (50%).
evidence: Tutor set: 1 wrong-Unsure, 1 wrong-Confident, 1 right-Guess, 1 right-Unsure -> IndexedDB srs table has 4 q: rows, page says "3 question(s) were added" (review/screens/uj-j3-d-06-results.png). Test set with 2 answered correctly and 2 unanswered -> "50% ... 2 questions were left unanswered and scored as wrong. Clean sweep." (review/screens/uj-j3-d-12-test-results.png).
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Compute the count from the same rule as scheduling (answered && needsRequeue(correct, confidence ?? "confident")), and show "Clean sweep" only when every item was answered correctly with confidence; otherwise say e.g. "No questions were added to review; 2 unanswered questions were scored wrong."
expected: The count matches the questions actually queued; "Clean sweep" only for a perfect set.
observed: Undercounts by the Unsure-correct items; "Clean sweep" at 50%.
steps: Practice a module in tutor mode answering one item correctly with "Unsure"; then run a 4-question test-mode set leaving 2 unanswered.

issue: In test mode an answer chosen without a confidence rating is scored, and the question navigator marks it answered, but the header and Submit button count it as unanswered ("0/4 answered"). Submitting with unanswered questions gives no warning or confirmation.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j3-m-11-test-last.png, review/screens/uj-j3-d-11-test-last.png. Steps: #/practice -> tick Area I -> 4 questions -> Test -> Timed -> Start; pick a choice on Q1 only -> header shows "0/4 answered" while the navigator square 1 is filled; Q1 is later scored Correct. On Q4 "Submit set (1/4)" submits at once.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Count answeredCount by `choice` alone in test mode (confidence is optional there), and when unanswered items remain show a confirm step ("2 questions unanswered will be scored wrong. Submit anyway?") listing them.
expected: One definition of "answered" across header, navigator and scoring; a confirmation before submitting with blanks.
observed: Header says 0 answered while the navigator and scoring treat the item as answered; no confirmation.
steps: Run a test-mode custom set as above.

issue: Keyboard shortcut race: pressing a choice letter and then a confidence digit in quick succession (under ~50 ms, e.g. a fast typist or a key macro) drops the confidence key silently, because the hotkey handler checks the rendered `selected` prop, which updates only after the IndexedDB write round-trips.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j3c-d-keyboard-race.png. Steps (desktop): #/practice/start?module=far-bonds -> press "d" then "2" back-to-back -> D is selected (aria-checked=true) but no feedback appears; pressing "2" again submits. With a 150 ms gap it works first time.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Track the last chosen letter in a ref inside McqView (set on onSelect) and let the confidence key use it when `selected` has not caught up yet.

issue: A flashcard session has no way to stop early: there is no End/Exit button, Escape does nothing, and the "Flashcard decks" navigation entry (same route) keeps the learner inside the session because the session lives in component state. The only exit is to navigate to a different page.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j4-d-07-nav-decks-still-in-session.png, review/screens/uj-j4-m-07-nav-decks-still-in-session.png. Steps: complete a lesson -> #/flashcards?module=far-income-statement-oci -> "Study this deck" -> click "Flashcard decks" in the sidebar (desktop) or More > Flashcard decks (phone) -> still on the card ("8 left in this session"); press Escape -> still in session.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Add an "End session" button beside "N left in this session" that calls onDone (graded cards are already saved), and reset `session` when the location key changes (or put the session in the URL, e.g. ?study=1) so the nav entry returns to the deck list.
expected: A visible way to end a session; the "Flashcard decks" link shows the deck list.
observed: No exit control; the nav link leaves the learner on the card.
steps: Start any flashcard session and try to get back to the deck list.

issue: Cards graded Again/Hard/Good on a new card are rescheduled minutes later (1m / 6m / 10m), but if the learner reloads or leaves, those cards are not in the resumed session and the review page says "0 due" until the minutes pass; the done screen never says they will return later today.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j4-d-03-card-back.png (grade labels "Again 1m, Hard 6m, Good 10m, Easy 8d"), review/screens/uj-j4-d-04-after-reload.png ("0 due · 4 new today" after grading 4 of 8). Steps: study 8 new cards, grade the first four Again/Hard/Good/Easy, reload.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: On the done screen and the review page, show "N cards come back in a few minutes" (count of srs cards due later today), and offer a short "Study again" when they become due.

issue: Rows labelled only "1"…"7" (the situations live in an exhibit tab). On a phone there is no split view, so the learner must switch between the "Situations" tab and the "Task" tab for every row, and the results list shows "✗ 1 — You: Not a violation · Answer: Violation" without restating the situation. Same pattern in far-tbs-r3-property-tax, aud-tbs-r3-journal-entries and aud-tbs-r3-it-coso.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j5-m-aud-tbs-r3-conduct-rules-b-partial-full.png (phone: seven selects labelled 1–7, results "✗ 1"). Steps: phone viewport -> #/tbs/aud-tbs-r3-conduct-rules -> answer the 7 rows (each needs a trip to the "Situations" tab) -> submit with row 1 wrong.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Give each row a short descriptive label (e.g. "1. Contingent fee — original return"), or on narrow screens render the matching exhibit paragraph under each row label; in TbsResults show the row label text plus the situation excerpt.
expected: Each row and each result cell identifies the situation it scores.
observed: Bare numbers; the phone layout forces tab switching per row.
steps: Open the TBS on a 390px viewport.

issue: Submitting a simulation scrolls to the very bottom of the page, past the "Score: x/y cells" heading, so on both viewports the learner first sees the last cell and the action buttons, not the score. "Submit" with blank cells and "Try again from scratch" (which deletes the saved run) both act without confirmation.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j5-d-far-tbs-u1-income-statement-b-partial-score.png (viewport after submit: last cells and buttons, no score heading). Code: TbsPage.submit() -> window.scrollTo({ top: document.body.scrollHeight }).
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Scroll the #tbs-results heading into view and focus it; confirm "Submit with N blank cells?" and "Discard this attempt and start over?".

issue: Submitting a testlet asks only "Submit testlet N? You will not be able to return to it." It does not say how many questions are unanswered or which are flagged for review, so the flag-for-review tool never pays off at the one moment it matters (the real exam shows a review summary before a testlet is submitted).
evidence: review/screens/uj-j6-d-07-submit-confirm.png (testlet 1 with Q3 flagged: confirm text has no mention of it). Testlet 2 submitted with 5 of 25 unanswered: same text, no warning. Steps: #/exam -> Start FAR Simulated Exam 1 -> flag Q3 -> answer 20 of 25 in testlet 2 -> "Submit testlet".
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: In the confirm card list "Unanswered: 21, 22, 23, 24, 25" and "Flagged: 3" as buttons that jump to the item, and make the primary action read "Submit with 5 unanswered" when any are blank.
expected: A pre-submit summary of unanswered and flagged items.
steps: Flag an item, leave some blank, press "Submit testlet".

issue: The calculator and spreadsheet open as fixed panels that cannot be moved. On a phone the calculator (256×344 px at y 404–748 of 844) covers the lower stem and choices A–B, and the spreadsheet covers most of the screen. The calculator also ignores Backspace and loses its display and memory each time it is closed and reopened.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j6-m-02-calculator-overlay.png, review/screens/uj-j6-m-03-spreadsheet-overlay.png, review/screens/uj-j6-d-04-calculator.png. Steps: phone viewport -> start a mock -> tap the calculator icon. Desktop: 100 / 3 = 33.3333333333, Backspace -> unchanged; close and reopen -> display "0", memory cleared.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Make the panels draggable (or dock them as a collapsible bottom sheet on narrow screens that pushes content up), handle Backspace to delete the last digit, and keep calculator state in the parent (ExamRunner/QuizPlayer) so closing only hides it.
expected: Tools that can be moved off the item and keep their state while the item is open.
observed: Fixed overlays covering the question; state reset on close; no Backspace.
steps: Open the calculator on a 390px viewport during a mock exam.

issue: On the last testlet the button says "Submit exam", but the confirmation still reads "Submit testlet 5? You will not be able to return to it." with a "Submit testlet" button, so it is not clear that this ends the exam and shows the score.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j6-d-11-final-confirm.png. Steps: reach testlet 5 of FAR Simulated Exam 1 -> "Submit exam".
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: When testletIndex is the last, word the card "Submit the exam? This ends the exam and shows your results." with a "Submit exam" button.

issue: The exam clock is paused while the optional-break offer is on screen (isExamClockPaused returns true when breakOffered && !breakUsed), not only during the break itself. A candidate can sit on the offer, or "Save & exit" from it, and the 4-hour clock never runs.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j6-d-09-break-offer.png. Steps: submit testlet 3 -> on "Optional break" the clock reads 3:59:21 and still 3:59:21 three seconds later. The break itself paused correctly (break 14:59 -> 14:56, exam clock unchanged) and survived a reload (review/screens/uj-j6-d-10-break.png).
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Start the break automatically when it is offered (the break timer runs; "Skip break" ends it), or let the exam clock run on the offer screen, so there is no state in which neither clock runs.

issue: Exam highlights are dropped whenever the candidate moves to another question or reloads (they reset per question by design). On the real exam, highlights stay on an item while the testlet is open, so returning to a flagged question loses the marks made the first time.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j6-d-03-flag-strike-highlight.png (highlight on Q3) and review/screens/uj-j6-d-06-after-reload.png (after reload CSS.highlights size 0). Strike-outs are also reset.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Persist highlight ranges (as text offsets) and strike-outs per item in the testlet state (ExamTestletState), restoring them when the item is shown again.

issue: When the exam is days away the planner contradicts its own advice. With the FAR exam in 3 days the status says "too close to cover everything left. Focus on spaced review, mixed practice and your weakest areas", yet the schedule puts a 4-hour mock exam today (before any lesson) and fills tomorrow with about 15 new lessons and practice sets (learning work "spills into final review if behind"). With the exam tomorrow, "Final review starts" shows Mon, Oct 26, a date already past.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j7a-d-3days-plan.png (exam 2026-10-31, 6 h/day: Today = "Full simulated exam (4 hours)"; Thu = 54 min review + Lesson/Practice set × 7…), review/screens/uj-j7a-d-tomorrow-plan.png ("Final review starts Mon, Oct 26" on Wed Oct 28). Steps: onboard FAR -> Settings -> FAR exam date = today + 3 (or + 1), all sliders 6 h -> #/plan.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: When !onTrack && totalDays < 7, stop scheduling new lessons (or cap them to the highest-weight unstarted modules) and fill the days with review, mixed practice and weak-area work as the message says; skip the mock when fewer than ~5 days remain or no lesson is done; clamp finalReviewStart to today.
expected: The schedule follows the stated strategy; no past dates in the summary.
observed: New lessons and a same-day mock scheduled under a "focus on review" message; final review "starts" two days ago.
steps: Set an exam date 1 and 3 days out and open the study plan.

issue: An exam date in the past is shown as if it were still upcoming. The dashboard switches to "FAR study home" but still reads "Exam on Sunday, October 18, 2026" with no warning, and the plan card is headed "On track" (green on the dashboard) above "Your exam date (2026-10-18) has passed." The onboarding and Settings date fields accept past dates without comment (no min).
evidence: review/screens/uj-j7a-d-past-plan.png ("On track" + "has passed"), review/screens/uj-j7a-d-past-dashboard.png. Steps: Settings -> FAR exam date = today − 10 -> Home, then Study plan. Onboarding accepted 2026-01-01 the same way (journey 1).
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Set onTrack=false (or a neutral status) when examPassed and title the card "Exam date passed"; on the dashboard show "Your FAR exam date has passed — set a new date" instead of "Exam on …"; add min={today} (or an inline warning) to the date inputs in Onboarding.tsx and SettingsPage.tsx.
expected: A clear "date passed" state, not "On track".
observed: "On track" with a passed date; the dashboard shows the old date as the exam date.

issue: Daily study time is capped at 6 h by the sliders (max=360), so the most a learner can enter is 42 h/week; a full-time candidate planning 60 h/week (8–9 h/day) cannot express it. Separately, a far-off exam (800 days) shows only the first 400 days of the plan (MAX_PLAN_DAYS) with no note that later days, the final-review weeks and exam day are not listed.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j7a-d-max-sliders.png (all seven sliders at 6 h), review/screens/uj-j7a-d-800days-plan.png (Final review starts Fri, Dec 22 [2028]; list ends after 400 days). Steps: Settings -> drag every slider to the right; then set the exam date 800 days out.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Raise the slider max to 600–720 min (or add a numeric hours field), and when the plan is truncated add a closing line "Plan shown through <date>; it extends as the exam approaches."

issue: Restoring a backup on a new device (the documented way to move devices: "export here and import there") requires completing onboarding first. Until then every route, including #/settings, redirects to #/welcome, and onboarding has no "restore from backup" option; the answers given there are then overwritten by the import.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j7b-d-09-after-reset-settings-redirect.png. Steps: Settings -> Reset everything (confirm) -> open #/settings -> redirected to #/welcome; only after onboarding (AUD, no date) could the backup be imported, which then replaced the AUD choice with the backed-up FAR settings.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Add "Restore from a backup file" to the first onboarding step (reusing SettingsPage.doImport) and let the Gate allow #/settings before onboarding, or mark the restored settings as onboarded so the learner lands on the dashboard.
expected: A restore option on the welcome screen.
observed: Restore is reachable only after a full onboarding whose answers are then discarded.
steps: Reset everything (or use a fresh browser), then try to import a backup.

issue: Two different pacing targets: Analytics shows "Exam pace ≈ 144s" per MCQ (half of 240 minutes over 50 MCQs), while the practice builder ("Timed (90 seconds per question — close to exam pace)"), the practice results ("target about 1:30") and the mock pacing table (90 s per MCQ) all use 90 s.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j7b-d-01-analytics.png (AVG TIME / MCQ tile: "Exam pace ≈ 144s"), review/screens/uj-j3-d-06-results.png ("target about 1:30"). Code: Analytics.tsx computes (durationMinutes*60)/2/mcqCount; pacing.ts MCQ_TARGET_MS = 90 000.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Use MCQ_TARGET_MS in the Analytics hint ("Target ≈ 90s"), or explain both numbers ("90 s target; the exam allows about 144 s if time is split evenly").
expected: One pacing target across the app.
observed: 144 s on Analytics, 90 s everywhere else.
steps: Answer a few questions and open Analytics.

issue: A "Question" search hit opens the module lesson page (to: /module/<moduleId>), not the question, so the learner cannot find the matched item there; the result count tops out at "50 result(s)" because of the result limit, without saying more exist.
evidence: review/screens/uj-j7b-d-04-search-question-hit.png (clicked a "Current tax expense is $47,500…" question hit -> landed on #/module/far-income-taxes, "Accounting for income taxes"). review/screens/uj-j7b-d-02-search.png ("deferred tax": "50 result(s)").
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Link question hits to a one-question practice set (e.g. /practice/start?item=<id>) or show the question inline in the results; show "50+ results — refine your search" when the limit is hit.

issue: When a new version is deployed during a practice set on a phone, the update toast (fixed bottom-4, z-50) sits on top of the quiz's sticky Previous/Skip/Next bar and the bottom navigation, and in a busy session its only control, "Later", is btn-ghost text-slate-700 on bg-slate-900 (about 1.7:1 contrast; in dark mode slate-200 on slate-100, about 1.1:1), so it is close to invisible. The learner loses the navigation controls mid-set until they find the faint "Later".
evidence: review/screens/uj-j8u-m-01-update-toast-quiz.png (phone, practice set: toast y 744–828 px over the quiz controls y 719–780 and the bottom nav y 789–844; "Later" barely visible), review/screens/uj-j8u-d-02-update-toast-dashboard.png (desktop: "Later" next to "Reload" is unreadable). Steps: serve dist/ with a byte-changed sw.js (scripts/bumpserver.cjs on :4173, GET /__bump) -> phone viewport -> open #/practice/start?module=far-bonds -> registration.update() -> toast "A new version is ready. You can reload once you finish or leave this session."
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Give "Later" a visible style on the dark toast (e.g. text-white underline, or btn-secondary), and position the toast above the sticky quiz bar and bottom nav on phones (bottom: calc(4rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 4rem)) or at the top of the screen; in busy routes use a slim one-line banner that does not cover controls.
expected: A dismissible notice that never covers the session controls, with a readable dismiss button.
observed: The toast covers Previous/Skip/Next and the nav; "Later" is ~1.7:1.
steps: Trigger a service-worker update while a quiz is open on a 390px viewport.

issue: Updates are only discovered when the page loads: useRegisterSW({ immediate: true }) sets up no periodic registration.update(), and the app is a HashRouter SPA, so an installed PWA or a tab left open for days never learns about a new deploy until it is relaunched. "Later" hides the toast until the next full load (it does reappear after a reload, and Reload is correctly withheld during quizzes, simulations and mocks).
evidence: Code reading of UpdatePrompt.tsx; in the walkthrough the toast appeared only after an explicit registration.update() (logs/j8u-run.txt). Behaviour verified: busy routes show no Reload; after leaving the quiz Reload appears; after "Later" + in-app navigation no toast; after a plain reload it returns; Reload activates the new worker and an in-progress mock stays resumable.
source: Hands-on walkthrough (Playwright, Chromium) of the built app on vite preview :4173
fix: Pass onRegisteredSW(url, r) { setInterval(() => r?.update(), 60 * 60 * 1000) } and also call r.update() on visibilitychange to visible.
